description: This file extends the ChannelsStore class with asynchronous methods to load and apply configuration schemas and data, manage configuration values, and save or reload drafts. It handles interactions with a gateway, manages internal state for configuration loading, and processes configuration paths.

classes.name: ChannelsStore
classes.description: A class (likely a singleton or manager) responsible for managing channels and their configurations, extended with methods for configuration handling.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the configuration schema from a gateway and updates internal state.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Fetches the current configuration snapshot asynchronously and updates internal configuration states.

methods.name: applyUIConfig
methods.description: Applies UI-related configuration, specifically the 'seamColor' setting, from a configuration snapshot.

methods.name: channelConfigSchema
methods.description: Returns the configuration schema node for a given channel ID.

methods.name: configValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value at a specified path, with specific fallback logic for 'channels' paths.

methods.name: updateConfigValue
methods.description: Updates the configuration draft at the specified path with a new value.

methods.name: saveConfigDraft
methods.description: Saves the current config draft asynchronously and reloads the configuration afterward.

methods.name: reloadConfigDraft
methods.description: Reloads the configuration by calling loadConfig.
